data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

edge_embedded.name: knowledge-work-plugins
edge_embedded.summary: 该仓库为知识工作者提供可在Claude Cowork中使用的开源插件，扩展AI协作工具能力。插件基于模块化Python脚本实现，通过Claude插件API进行交互，支持文档分析、数据提取与工作流自动化。技术亮点在于可扩展架构：开发者可复刻仓库，修改或创建插件以适配特定场景，如自动总结论文或提取结构化数据。这些插件降低了AI集成到知识工作流程的门槛，适合需定制化AI助手的团队或个人。
edge_embedded.summary_en: This repository provides open-source plugins for knowledge workers to use within Claude Cowork, an AI-powered collaboration tool. The plugins extend Claude's capabilities for tasks like document analysis, data extraction, and workflow automation. Technically, they are modular Python scripts that interface with Claude via a plugin API, enabling custom tool integration. Developers can fork the repo, adapt existing plugins, or create new ones to automate repetitive knowledge work tasks, such as summarizing research papers or extracting structured data from reports.

ui_devex.name: cmux
ui_devex.summary: cmux 是一款基于 Ghostty 的 macOS 终端，专为 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Codex）设计，通过垂直标签页和通知功能解决了多代理会话管理难题。其技术亮点在于利用 Ghostty 的 GPU 加速渲染保证性能，同时扩展了自定义标签管理界面。开发者可同时运行多个 AI 代理，通过垂直标签页追踪输出，并在任务完成时接收通知，非常适合复杂的多代理工作流。例如，你可以让一个代理编写代码，另一个代理审查，第三个代理运行测试，所有输出一目了然。
ui_devex.summary_en: cmux is a macOS terminal built on Ghostty, designed to enhance AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It adds vertical tabs and notifications, solving the problem of managing multiple agent sessions in a standard terminal. Technically, it leverages Ghostty's GPU-accelerated rendering for performance while extending its UI with custom tab management. Developers can use cmux to run multiple AI agents simultaneously, track their outputs via vertical tabs, and receive notifications on task completion, making it ideal for complex, multi-agent workflows.

agents_workflows.name: pi
agents_workflows.summary: pi 是一个开源的 AI 智能体工具包，旨在简化编码智能体的构建与部署。它提供统一的 LLM API、编码智能体命令行界面、终端与 Web UI 库，以及 Slack 机器人和 vLLM 推理 pod 支持。其核心优势在于模块化设计，开发者可以灵活组合 CLI、UI 库和 LLM 后端等组件。你可以用 pi 快速搭建自定义编码助手，将 AI 集成到 Slack 工作流中，或利用 vLLM 部署可扩展的推理集群。
agents_workflows.summary_en: pi is an open-source AI agent toolkit that simplifies building and deploying coding agents. It provides a unified LLM API, a coding agent CLI, and libraries for TUI and web UIs, along with a Slack bot and vLLM pod support. Its key strength is the modular design, allowing developers to mix and match components like the CLI, UI libraries, and LLM backends. You can use pi to quickly create custom coding assistants, integrate AI into Slack workflows, or deploy scalable inference pods with vLLM.

agents_workflows.name: knowledge-work-plugins
agents_workflows.summary: 该仓库为知识工作者提供可在Claude Cowork中使用的开源插件，扩展AI协作工具能力。插件基于模块化Python脚本实现，通过Claude插件API进行交互，支持文档分析、数据提取与工作流自动化。技术亮点在于可扩展架构：开发者可复刻仓库，修改或创建插件以适配特定场景，如自动总结论文或提取结构化数据。这些插件降低了AI集成到知识工作流程的门槛，适合需定制化AI助手的团队或个人。
agents_workflows.summary_en: This repository provides open-source plugins for knowledge workers to use within Claude Cowork, an AI-powered collaboration tool. The plugins extend Claude's capabilities for tasks like document analysis, data extraction, and workflow automation. Technically, they are modular Python scripts that interface with Claude via a plugin API, enabling custom tool integration. Developers can fork the repo, adapt existing plugins, or create new ones to automate repetitive knowledge work tasks, such as summarizing research papers or extracting structured data from reports.

deployment_serving.name: pi
deployment_serving.summary: pi 是一个开源的 AI 智能体工具包，旨在简化编码智能体的构建与部署。它提供统一的 LLM API、编码智能体命令行界面、终端与 Web UI 库，以及 Slack 机器人和 vLLM 推理 pod 支持。其核心优势在于模块化设计，开发者可以灵活组合 CLI、UI 库和 LLM 后端等组件。你可以用 pi 快速搭建自定义编码助手，将 AI 集成到 Slack 工作流中，或利用 vLLM 部署可扩展的推理集群。
deployment_serving.summary_en: pi is an open-source AI agent toolkit that simplifies building and deploying coding agents. It provides a unified LLM API, a coding agent CLI, and libraries for TUI and web UIs, along with a Slack bot and vLLM pod support. Its key strength is the modular design, allowing developers to mix and match components like the CLI, UI libraries, and LLM backends. You can use pi to quickly create custom coding assistants, integrate AI into Slack workflows, or deploy scalable inference pods with vLLM.
